sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: No data available from World Bank or ECB

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Pulp mill dispute with Uruguay escalates
geopolitical_news.summary: Argentina takes Uruguay to the International Court of Justice over mills on the shared river as bridge blockades continue.

geopolitical_news.headline: Dictatorship-trial witness disappears
geopolitical_news.summary: Julio López vanishes in September after testifying against a former police chief, sparking national outrage and a fruitless search.

sport.headline: World Cup quarter-final exit to Germany
sport.summary: Argentina loses on penalties in Berlin; coach José Pekerman resigns after the defeat.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cristina Kirchner elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: She wins October's vote to succeed her husband Néstor, becoming Argentina's first elected woman president.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cash-smuggling scandal strains Venezuela ties
geopolitical_news.summary: The Antonini Wilson suitcase case links Venezuelan funds to the Kirchner campaign, embarrassing both governments.

sport.headline: Copa América final defeat to Brazil
sport.summary: Argentina loses 3-0 in Venezuela, but the under-20s win the World Cup with Sergio Agüero starring.

geopolitical_news.headline: Farm export-tax revolt paralyzes government
geopolitical_news.summary: Four months of farmer strikes over Resolution 125 end when the Senate rejects the mobile export-tax hike.

geopolitical_news.headline: Government seizes private pension funds
geopolitical_news.summary: Cristina nationalizes the AFJP pension system in November, citing the global financial crisis.

sport.headline: Olympic football gold in Beijing
sport.summary: Messi and Agüero lead Argentina to a second straight Olympic title, beating Nigeria in the final.

geopolitical_news.headline: Kirchnerism routed in midterm elections
geopolitical_news.summary: The government's list loses Buenos Aires province in June, weakening Cristina ahead of the 2011 race.

geopolitical_news.headline: Media law battle with Clarín begins
geopolitical_news.summary: Congress passes a law to break up the Clarín group, opening a years-long legal and political war.

sport.headline: Last-gasp World Cup qualification
sport.summary: Palermo's late winner against Peru and victory in Uruguay seal qualification under coach Maradona.

geopolitical_news.headline: Néstor Kirchner dies suddenly
geopolitical_news.summary: The former president dies of a heart attack in October, reshaping Cristina's government and the 2011 race.

geopolitical_news.headline: Same-sex marriage legalized
geopolitical_news.summary: Argentina becomes the first Latin American country to legalize gay marriage in July.

sport.headline: World Cup quarter-final humiliation by Germany
sport.summary: A 4-0 defeat in Cape Town ends Maradona's coaching reign; Messi leaves the tournament scoreless.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cristina re-elected in landslide
geopolitical_news.summary: She wins 54 percent in October's first round, the widest margin since the return of democracy.

geopolitical_news.headline: Currency controls introduced
geopolitical_news.summary: 'Cepo' restrictions on dollar purchases begin as capital flight accelerates.

sport.headline: Copa América flop on home soil
sport.summary: Argentina exits in the quarter-finals to Uruguay on penalties despite hosting the tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: YPF renationalized from Spain's Repsol
geopolitical_news.summary: Congress expropriates a 51 percent stake in April, triggering a diplomatic row with Madrid.

geopolitical_news.headline: Mass cacerolazo protests erupt
geopolitical_news.summary: Hundreds of thousands march in November against inflation, crime and corruption.

sport.headline: Messi scores record 91 goals in a year
sport.summary: He breaks Gerd Müller's 40-year record in December, capping a historic Barcelona season.

geopolitical_news.headline: IMF censures Argentina over inflation data
geopolitical_news.summary: The Fund issues a rare censure in February over doctored official statistics.

geopolitical_news.headline: Argentine cardinal becomes Pope Francis
geopolitical_news.summary: Jorge Bergoglio's March election thrills the country; Cristina attends the inauguration.

sport.headline: World Cup qualification sealed top of group
sport.summary: Argentina books Brazil 2014 with games to spare as Messi stars in qualifying.

geopolitical_news.headline: Default on holdout 'vulture fund' debt
geopolitical_news.summary: Argentina defaults in July after US courts block payments unless holdout creditors are paid in full.

geopolitical_news.headline: Peso sharply devalued
geopolitical_news.summary: The government lets the peso slide in January as foreign reserves drain.

sport.headline: World Cup final heartbreak against Germany
sport.summary: Götze's extra-time goal in Rio denies Argentina a third title; Messi wins the Golden Ball.

geopolitical_news.headline: Prosecutor Nisman found dead
geopolitical_news.summary: Alberto Nisman is found shot in January, days before testifying that Cristina covered up the AMIA bombing probe.

geopolitical_news.headline: Macri ends 12 years of Kirchnerism
geopolitical_news.summary: Mauricio Macri beats Daniel Scioli in November's runoff, the country's first ever presidential ballotage.

sport.headline: Copa América final loss to Chile
sport.summary: Argentina falls on penalties in Santiago; Messi misses in the shootout.

geopolitical_news.headline: Argentina settles with holdout creditors
geopolitical_news.summary: Macri's government pays billions to end the 15-year debt saga and returns to bond markets.

geopolitical_news.headline: 'Panama Papers' implicate Macri
geopolitical_news.summary: Leaked documents link the president to offshore firms, though he denies wrongdoing.

sport.headline: Copa América final defeat prompts Messi retirement
sport.summary: A third straight final loss, again to Chile on penalties, leads Messi to briefly quit the national team.

geopolitical_news.headline: Activist Maldonado found dead
geopolitical_news.summary: Santiago Maldonado's body is found in October after a 78-day disappearance that polarized the country.

geopolitical_news.headline: Macri wins midterm elections
geopolitical_news.summary: Cambiemos triumphs nationally in October, strengthening the reform agenda.

sport.headline: Messi hat-trick rescues World Cup qualification
sport.summary: His three goals in Quito against Ecuador seal a last-day ticket to Russia 2018.

geopolitical_news.headline: Record $57bn IMF bailout agreed
geopolitical_news.summary: A peso collapse forces Macri to seek the largest loan in IMF history in June.

geopolitical_news.headline: Buenos Aires hosts G20 summit
geopolitical_news.summary: Trump, Putin and Xi attend the November summit amid tight security.

sport.headline: World Cup last-16 exit to France
sport.summary: A 4-3 thriller in Kazan ends Argentina's campaign; coach Sampaoli departs.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fernández defeats Macri
geopolitical_news.summary: Alberto Fernández, with Cristina as running mate, wins October's election on economic discontent.

geopolitical_news.headline: Markets crash after primary shock
geopolitical_news.summary: The peso and stocks plunge in August when Fernández trounces Macri in the PASO primary.

sport.headline: Copa América semi-final loss to Brazil
sport.summary: A 2-0 defeat in Belo Horizonte ends the title bid; Messi alleges corruption in officiating.

geopolitical_news.headline: Sovereign debt restructured
geopolitical_news.summary: After months of talks, Argentina seals a $65bn bond restructuring deal in August.

geopolitical_news.headline: Abortion legalized
geopolitical_news.summary: Congress legalizes abortion up to 14 weeks in December after a historic feminist campaign.

sport.headline: Maradona dies aged 60
sport.summary: The nation's idol dies of a heart attack in November; three days of national mourning are declared.

geopolitical_news.headline: 'VIP vaccination' scandal topples minister
geopolitical_news.summary: Health minister Ginés González García resigns in February over preferential vaccine access.

geopolitical_news.headline: Government crushed in midterms
geopolitical_news.summary: The ruling coalition loses control of Congress in November amid soaring inflation.

sport.headline: Copa América triumph at the Maracanã
sport.summary: Di María's goal beats Brazil 1-0 in the final, ending a 28-year trophy drought.

geopolitical_news.headline: Vice president survives assassination attempt
geopolitical_news.summary: Cristina Kirchner is attacked at point-blank range in September; the gun misfires.

geopolitical_news.headline: Inflation nears 100 percent
geopolitical_news.summary: Annual inflation hits about 95 percent in December as the economy unravels.

sport.headline: World Cup champions in Qatar
sport.summary: Argentina beats France on penalties in a classic final; Messi finally lifts the trophy.

geopolitical_news.headline: Milei wins presidency
geopolitical_news.summary: Libertarian outsider Javier Milei beats Sergio Massa in November's runoff on a radical free-market platform.

geopolitical_news.headline: Primary shock rattles markets
geopolitical_news.summary: Milei's surprise PASO win in August sends the peso tumbling and inflation soaring.

sport.headline: Messi joins Inter Miami
sport.summary: After leaving PSG, the World Cup winner moves to MLS in a landmark July transfer.

geopolitical_news.headline: Milei achieves fiscal surplus
geopolitical_news.summary: Drastic spending cuts deliver monthly budget surpluses, though poverty spikes above 50 percent.

geopolitical_news.headline: 'Ley Bases' reform package passes
geopolitical_news.summary: Congress approves Milei's sweeping deregulation bill in June after months of protests.

sport.headline: Copa América title retained
sport.summary: Lautaro Martínez's extra-time goal beats Colombia in the Miami final for a record 16th title.

geopolitical_news.headline: '$LIBRA' crypto scandal engulfs Milei
geopolitical_news.summary: The president promotes a memecoin in February that collapses within hours, sparking fraud probes.

geopolitical_news.headline: Milei's party wins midterms
geopolitical_news.summary: La Libertad Avanza triumphs in October's legislative elections, consolidating power in Congress.

sport.headline: World Cup 2026 qualification secured
sport.summary: Argentina becomes the first South American team to book its ticket, sealing it in March.
